mapper.select: SELECT id, title, industry, period_start AS periodStart, period_end AS periodEnd, summary, content, generated_at AS generatedAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM industry_reports WHERE id = #{reportId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO industry_reports (title, industry, period_start, period_end, summary, content, generated_at, created_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{industry}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{generatedAt}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO salary_trends (report_id, period, avg_salary, job_count) VALUES
(#{item.reportId}, #{item.period}, #{item.avgSalary}, #{item.jobCount})
mapper.select: SELECT dd.id, dd.report_id AS reportId, dd.dimension_type AS dimensionType, dd.label, dd.count, dd.percentage FROM demand_distributions dd WHERE dd.dimension_type = #{dimensionType} ORDER BY dd.count DESC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO demand_distributions (report_id, dimension_type, label, count, percentage) VALUES
(#{item.reportId}, #{item.dimensionType}, #{item.label}, #{item.count}, #{item.percentage})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_postings jp JOIN enterprise_profiles ep ON jp.enterprise_user_id = ep.user_id WHERE ep.industry = #{industry} AND jp.status = 'OPEN'

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG((jp.min_salary + jp.max_salary) / 2)), 0) FROM job_postings jp JOIN enterprise_profiles ep ON jp.enterprise_user_id = ep.user_id WHERE ep.industry = #{industry} AND jp.status = 'OPEN' AND jp.min_salary IS NOT NULL AND jp.max_salary IS NOT NULL

SELECT COALESCE(jp.${column}, '其他') AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM job_postings jp JOIN enterprise_profiles ep ON jp.enterprise_user_id = ep.user_id WHERE ep.industry = #{industry} AND jp.status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY jp.${column} ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN jp.min_experience IS NULL AND jp.max_experience IS NULL THEN '经验不限' WHEN jp.max_experience <= 1 THEN '1年以下' WHEN jp.max_experience <= 3 THEN '1-3年' WHEN jp.max_experience <= 5 THEN '3-5年' WHEN jp.max_experience <= 10 THEN '5-10年' ELSE '10年以上' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM job_postings jp JOIN enterprise_profiles ep ON jp.enterprise_user_id = ep.user_id WHERE ep.industry = #{industry} AND jp.status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY label ORDER BY cnt DESC
